AnalogTape.name: Analog Tape
AnalogTape.description: Vintage home video wobble, bleed, and grain.

AudioVisualization.name: Audio Visualization
AudioVisualization.description: Render waveform, spectrum, and other transparent audio visualizations.

Bars.name: Bars
Bars.description: Add colored bars around your video.

BeatSync.name: Beat Sync
BeatSync.description: Generates an audio-reactive color flash layer, synchronized to the beat.

Blur.name: Blur
Blur.description: Adjust the blur of the frame's image.

Brightness.name: Brightness & Contrast
Brightness.description: Adjust the brightness and contrast of the frame's image.

Caption.name: Caption
Caption.description: Add text captions on top of your video.

caption_text.default:
00:00:00:000 --> 00:10:00:000
Edit this caption with our caption editor

ChromaKey.name: Chroma Key (Greenscreen)
ChromaKey.description: Replaces the color (or chroma) of the frame with transparency (i.e. keys out the color).

ColorGrade.name: Color Grade
ColorGrade.description: Unified color grading effect with curves, wheels and LUT support.

ColorMap.name: Color Map / Lookup
ColorMap.description: Adjust colors using 3D LUT lookup tables (.cube format)

ColorShift.name: Color Shift
ColorShift.description: Shift the colors of an image up, down, left, and right (with infinite wrapping).

Crop.name: Crop
Crop.description: Crop out any part of your video.

Deinterlace.name: Deinterlace
Deinterlace.description: Remove interlacing from a video (i.e. even or odd horizontal lines)

Displace.name: Displacement Map
Displace.description: Use a grayscale image or video to warp the frame in the horizontal and vertical directions.

FilmGrain.name: Film Grain
FilmGrain.description: Film-inspired grain texture with tonal, color, and temporal controls.

Glow.name: Glow
Glow.description: Add an outer or inner glow based on visible pixels.

Hue.name: Hue
Hue.description: Adjust the hue / color of the frame's image.

LensFlare.name: Lens Flare
LensFlare.description: Simulate sunlight hitting a lens with flares and spectral colors.

Mask.name: Alpha Mask / Wipe Transition
Mask.description: Uses a grayscale mask image to gradually wipe / transition between 2 images.

Negate.name: Negative
Negate.description: Negates the colors, producing a negative of the image.

Pixelate.name: Pixelate
Pixelate.description: Pixelate (increase or decrease) the number of visible pixels.

Sharpen.name: Sharpen
Sharpen.description: Boost edge contrast to make video details look crisper.

Shadow.name: Shadow
Shadow.description: Add a soft drop shadow based on visible pixels.

Shift.name: Shift
Shift.description: Shift the image up, down, left, and right (with infinite wrapping).

SphericalProjection.name: Spherical Projection
SphericalProjection.description: Flatten and reproject 360° or fisheye inputs into a rectilinear view with yaw, pitch, roll, and FOV. Supports Equirect and multiple fisheye lens models.

Timer.name: Timer
Timer.description: Render a styled count up, count down, clock, timecode, or frame number overlay.

DenoiseImage.name: Denoise Image
DenoiseImage.description: Reduces visible grain and color speckles in video frames.

Wave.name: Wave
Wave.description: Distort the frame's image into a wave pattern.

Noise.name: Noise
Noise.description: Random signal having equal intensity at different frequencies.

Delay.name: Delay
Delay.description: Adjust the synchronism between the audio and video track.

Echo.name: Echo
Echo.description: Reflection of sound with a delay after the direct sound.

Distortion.name: Distortion
Distortion.description: Alter the audio by clipping the signal.

ParametricEQ.name: Parametric EQ
ParametricEQ.description: Filter that allows you to adjust the volume level of a frequency in the audio track.

Compressor.name: Compressor
Compressor.description: Reduce the volume of loud sounds or amplify quiet sounds.

Expander.name: Expander
Expander.description: Louder parts of audio becomes relatively louder and quieter parts becomes quieter.

Robotization.name: Robotization
Robotization.description: Transform the voice present in an audio track into a robotic voice effect.

Whisperization.name: Whisperization
Whisperization.description: Transform the voice present in an audio track into a whispering voice effect.

Outline.name: Outline
Outline.description: Add outline around any image or text.

Stabilizer.name: Stabilizer
Stabilizer.description: Stabilize video clip to remove undesired shaking and jitter.

Tracker.name: Tracker
Tracker.description: Track the selected bounding box through the video.

ObjectMask.name: Object Mask
ObjectMask.description: Create and draw a segmentation mask for a prompted object.
